description: Needs a free TronRelic account: calling it makes your app ask the user to sign in, then the call runs. Fetch one PUBLISHED blog post by its id, including the full markdown body. Use after list-blog-posts to read a specific post in full (e.g. to summarise or quote it). The "id" is the value list-blog-posts returns on each row (a UUID). Read-only; never mutates. Returns { success: true, post: { id, slug, title, tags, bodyMarkdown, publishedAt, updatedAt } }, or { success: true, post: null } when no PUBLISHED post owns that id (an unpublished draft or unknown id both return null — this is a normal result, not an error). Never returns unpublished drafts. Reads blog posts only; a site page such as a guide or policy is read with pages-get.

inputSchema.description: The id of the published post to fetch.

id.description: The post id (a UUID) from a list-blog-posts row.

name: get-blog-post
title: Read a blog post
